status: Post hoc descriptive analysis of original opened test; supplementary analysis rule saved before supplementary results are analyzed
success_estimand: Mean of paired per-scene success indicators, weighting scenes equally in the observed dataset

bootstrap.unit: template_group; sample G groups with replacement and retain all variants of every selected group together
bootstrap.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles; descriptive, no significance tests or multiplicity claims
bootstrap.paired: Identical resampled groups for every method comparison in a dataset
bootstrap.continuous: Only the jointly complete-success subset for that comparison; missing or censored minima excluded with explicit denominator
bootstrap.group_weighting: Pooled scene statistic under group resampling; group sizes allowed to differ

original_comparisons: Each original PPO best vs tracking and fixed APF, plus last minus best per seed
supplementary_comparisons: Fixed and tuned APF vs tracking; tuned APF vs fixed APF; each original frozen PPO best vs tracking, fixed APF, and validation-selected tuned APF
all_method_common_success_table: Separate comparable continuous summaries on the intersection of all primary methods' complete successes; never include truncated failures as shorter successful runs
limitations: Template clusters themselves are not proven independent draws from a population; intervals are sensitivity summaries under this resampling model
Original test is opened, and supplementary scenes are from the known developed task family
Three policies do not create 393 independent scenes
No best policy is selected from either test dataset
No result-dependent dropping of methods, failed episodes, scene IDs, or template groups
